messages:
rebecca: Morning release ribbon. Deploy window 10:30-11:00 PT. Lane assignments below. I'll own smoke for core-api. Please confirm rollback readiness. @aj you on web deployment at 10:40?
aj: Yep, locked. CR 4521 merged. Will run pre-smoke at 10:35. :white_check_mark:
lina: I'm on embeddings service at 10:50. Need a quick DB migration runbook — ping @mike for timing.
mike: I wrote the migration script. Will be online at 10:45 to run and monitor. Rollback plan: runbook step 5 `pg_dump && rollback-toggle`. Keeping DB backup window 10:40-10:55.
sre-oncall: Heads up — I'll be running perf checks and watching tokens/sec, latency. If p95 > 300ms for >2min, we rollback. Will post alert channel.
devex: I posted the smoke checklist and a quick rollback command in #eng-releases-pinned (link). TL;DR:
```
# rollback to previous canary
kubectl rollout undo deploy/core-api --to-revision=3
```
rebecca: Great. @ops-bot schedule deploy reminder 10:25 for owners.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 10:25 PT ping to rebecca, aj, lina, mike, sre-oncall.
aj: CR note — if web canary fails, fallback to static assets cached at s3://resources/web-fallback.
lina: embedding service will seed cache before traffic. :rocket:
mike: DB migration will be feature-flagged; toggling with `featurectl env set embeddings_mig=true` after migration validated.
sre-oncall: Also canary traffic split 5% for first 3 minutes then 25% next 7 minutes. If errors spike, rollback to 0%.
rebecca: Ok team, final confirmations? Post :thumbsup: if ready.
aj: :thumbsup:
lina: :thumbsup:
mike: :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: :thumbsup:
rebecca: Closing loop — I'll declare success at 11:05 PT if all green. Thanks.
